title: Notification regarding application fee and application form
excerpt: The amendment adds Indian Postal Order after demand draft as a permitted payment method for applications, information charges, first appeals and second appeals; it also revises inspection timing and adds actual sample/model cost.
notes: Notification dated 23 April 2013 in Maharashtra Gazette Part IV-A for 9–15 May 2013. The image-based Marathi scan was extracted without executing the PDF and visually transcribed. Independent Marathi and legal/RTI review remain required before filing-ready activation.

technical.notes: Official scan, amendment targets and Indian Postal Order insertions visually verified.
